title: HumanReviewQueue
description: The HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED queue for one run (research §22). v2.1 (audit remediation): `run_state` is a REQUIRED derived field with an explicit precedence (M11); `candidates` reuses the shared `candidateEvidence` $def (L3).

candidates.description: literal_content (FR-062a): candidateEvidence with `value` (+ optional ocr_confidence). reading_order (FR-062d): candidateEvidence with `order:[segment_id]`; see segment_ids. Shared `candidateEvidence` $def (L3) — same shape carried by human-review-resolution / human-review-verification.

segment_ids.description: reading_order items only: the exact segment set an --order resolution must permute (FR-062d/FR-069).

segment_refs.description: FR-075: internal source-segment ids the reviewed content maps to (for the terminal to locate/show; kept for literal_content too).

structural_context.description: FR-075: where the extraction evidence knows it. All fields optional/nullable.

source_context_before.description: FR-075: short VERBATIM window of source text immediately before the disputed segment.

source_context_after.description: FR-075: short VERBATIM window of source text immediately after the disputed segment.

run_state.description: DERIVED (FR-077, research §22.4), not a stored flag. Evaluated in an EXPLICIT PRECEDENCE — FIRST MATCH WINS (M11): (1) unresolved — any queue item still `open` after applying the resolution store I1-I6 (a newly raised item ALWAYS wins here, regardless of a prior authorization for an earlier run_id); (2) delivery_blocked_verification_failed — no open items AND a human_review_verification record for the current run_id with summary.status == FAIL; (3) delivered — no open items AND <base>.md on disk matches this run's render AND (if >=1 applicable decision) a PASS verification for the current run_id AND (for `convert`) a traceability record for the current run_id; (4) authorized — no open items AND a review-authorizations.jsonl line with authorized_run_id == current run_id (render/verification may still be pending — a restart re-runs them deterministically); (5) resolved_unauthorized — no open items and none of the above. The array order here is the precedence order. Source of truth is the queue + resolution store + authorization event log + verification record + delivered bytes. There is NO persisted 'in-progress' state.

candidateEvidence.description: One candidate shown to the reviewer (FR-062a/FR-062d/FR-075). Shared shape reused by human-review-resolution.schema.json and human-review-verification.schema.json (L3).

provenance_label.description: FR-075: human-readable source label shown in the terminal, e.g. 'layout path (docling), p.5' / 'OCR (tesseract; pt; conf 82)'.
